description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Soraka''' [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] the target allied champion.
description.text: Active: Soraka heals the target allied champion.

description2.raw: If cast while under ''[[File:Soraka Starcall.png|20xpx|border|link=Soraka#Starcall|An icon for Soraka's ability Starcall]] [[Soraka#Starcall|Rejuvenation]]'', the health cost will be reduced by a percentage.
description2.text: If cast while under Rejuvenation, the health cost will be reduced by a percentage.

description3.raw: ''Astral Infusion'' cannot be cast if '''Soraka''' is below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 5% of her '''maximum''' health.
description3.text: Astral Infusion cannot be cast if Soraka is below  5% of her maximum health.

notes.raw: * ''Astral Infusion'' can also be targeted on allied [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|decoys]]. * ''Astral Infusion'' can be cast even if '''Soraka''' doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost while above [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 5% of her '''maximum''' health. ** As with all abilities with health costs, ''Astral Infusion'' will not reduce '''Soraka's''' health below 1. * [[File:Spirit Visage item.png|20xpx|border|link=Spirit Visage|An icon for the item Spirit Visage]] [[Spirit Visage]] will only increase the health donated to allies if the target ally possesses it, although owning it ''will'' boost the heal that '''Soraka''' receives from [[File:Soraka Starcall.png|20xpx|border|link=Soraka#Starcall|An icon for Soraka's ability Starcall]] [[Soraka#Starcall|Starcall]] and [[File:Soraka Wish.png|20xpx|border|link=Soraka#Wish|An icon for Soraka's ability Wish]] [[Soraka#Wish|Wish]]. * ''Astral Infusion's'' effects occur before the cast time. * ''Astral Infusion'' has a [[File:Targeting forgiveness.svg|20px|link=Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|An icon representing the keyword Targeting forgiveness]] [[:Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|forgiveness radius]] of 175 units.
notes.text:
Astral Infusion can also be targeted on allied decoys.
Astral Infusion can be cast even if Soraka doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost while above  5% of her maximum health.
* As with all abilities with health costs, Astral Infusion will not reduce Soraka's health below 1.
Spirit Visage will only increase the health donated to allies if the target ally possesses it, although owning it will boost the heal that Soraka receives from Starcall and Wish.
Astral Infusion's effects occur before the cast time.
Astral Infusion has a forgiveness radius of 175 units.
